Nutrient composition
Cabbage is high in vitamin C.  As a
cruciferous vegetable, it contains signifi-
cant amounts of nitrogen compounds
called indoles, which are phytochemicals
that may help prevent some types of
cancer.

atively good source of fiber.  In addition
